strategy.offer: Premium wood flooring collections, plus accessories, surface options, installation guidance, maintenance products, technical documentation and digital tools.
strategy.customers: Homeowners, renovators, architects, interior-focused consumers and trade professionals seeking floors matched to design styles and practical installation needs.

strategy.direction: Expand trend-led, style-oriented flooring with more natural aesthetics, calm finishes and easy-care performance for contemporary interiors.
